title: Evolutionary Adaptive Neighborhood Learning: A Genetic Algorithm for Instance-Dependent k Optimization in Nearest Neighbor Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.07257v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The number of neighbours k is the central hyperparameter of the k-nearest neighbour (k-NN) classifier and is usually selected globally through cross-validation or evolutionary search. However, the bias-variance trade-off is inherently local: dense and noise-free regions may favour small neighbourhoods, whereas sparse or noisy regions may require larger ones. Since global-k optimization is one-dimensional, replacing exhaustive search with a genetic algorithm offers little computational advantage. We therefore optimize an instance-dependent neighbourhood policy instead. We propose EANK (Evolutionary Adaptive Neighborhood K), which uses a low-dimensional policy to map local neighbourhood descriptors, including density, label entropy, vote margin, and concentration, to an adaptive number of neighbours k(x). A real-coded elitist genetic algorithm optimizes this policy using leave-one-out accuracy with a neighbourhood-smoothness penalty. Pre

translated_title: 进化自适应邻域学习：一种用于最近邻分类中实例依赖k优化的遗传算法
translated_abstract: 邻居数量k是k近邻（k-NN）分类器的核心超参数，通常通过交叉验证或进化搜索进行全局选择。然而，偏差-方差权衡本质上是局部性的：密集且无噪声的区域可能适合较小的邻域，而稀疏或有噪声的区域则可能需要更大的邻域。由于全局k优化是一维问题，用遗传算法替代穷举搜索几乎没有计算优势。因此，我们转而优化实例依赖的邻域策略。我们提出了EANK（进化自适应邻域K），它使用一个低维策略将局部邻域描述符（包括密度、标签熵、投票边际和集中度）映射到自适应的邻居数量k(x)。一个实数编码的精英遗传算法使用带邻域平滑性惩罚的留一法准确率来优化该策略。
tldr: 该论文提出EANK方法，通过遗传算法优化一个低维策略，根据局部邻域特征（密度、标签熵、投票边际、集中度）为每个实例自适应地确定k近邻分类器的邻居数量k(x)，突破了传统全局单一k值选择的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EANK, a genetic algorithm-optimized low-dimensional policy that adaptively determines instance-specific neighbor counts k(x) based on local neighborhood descriptors (density, label entropy, vote margin, and concentration), overcoming the limitation of global single-k selection in k-NN classification.
